name: WeChat
container: max-width: 720px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 16px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;
h1: font-size: 28px; font-weight: 600; color: #1a1a1a; margin: 24px 0 16px; text-align: center;
h2: font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; color: #1a1a1a; margin: 24px 0 12px; border-left: 4px solid #3498db; padding-left: 12px;
code_inline: background: #f5f5f5; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'SF Mono', Monaco, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 14px; color: #e74c3c;
code_block_header: display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 8px 12px; background: #21252b;
code_block_dots: width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; display: inline-block; margin-right: 6px;
code_block_content: padding: 16px; font-family: 'SF Mono', Monaco, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; color: #abb2bf; display: block;
blockquote: border-left: 4px solid #3498db; background: #f8f9fa; margin: 16px 0; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
ol: padding-left: 0; list-style-type: none; margin: 12px 0; counter-reset: ol-counter;
hr: margin: 32px auto; border: none; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, #ddd, transparent);
img: max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; margin: 16px auto; border-radius: 8px;
